# SOP-P3-L4-04 Shift handover - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01, EQ-P3-L4-HT02, EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Preconditions
1. Incoming and outgoing operators have read ECN-2026-001 and the applicable maintenance manuals MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-RR01.
2. All safety interlocks tested and green at source panel for EQ-P3-L4-RR01, EQ-P3-L4-HT02, EQ-P3-L4-SB03.
3. All abnormal conditions logged in shift log and cleared or tagged for follow-up.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
4. Required PPE for handover: safety glasses, ear protection, leather gloves, and steel-toe footwear.
5. Authorized personnel only in machine access zones; respirator as required per MM-P3-L4-HT02 when accessing HT02 service ports.

Shift handover procedure
6. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator on current running status of EQ-P3-L4-HT02 and EQ-P3-L4-RR01, including any alarms, manual overrides, and parts in process.
7. Verify material flow and rack inventory with physical confirmation at EQ-P3-L4-RR01 staging area.
8. Inspect EQ-P3-L4-SB03 for debris, wear, and loose guards. The lubricant part number for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is CFW-LUB-526.
9. Confirm maintenance actions completed and record references to MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-RR01 where maintenance was performed.
10. For EQ-P3-L4-SB03, verify blast wheel liner fasteners per maintenance checklist. The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 90 N·m.
11. Report unresolved maintenance items to on-shift supervisor and tag equipment per ECN-2026-001 if out-of-service.

Communications and escalation
12. Document all handover notes in the electronic shift log. Escalate safety-critical items immediately to the on-shift lead.

Sign-off
13. Outgoing operator: ____________________  
14. Incoming operator: ____________________  
15. On-shift supervisor: ____________________  

Related documents: ECN-2026-001, MM-P3-L4-HT02, MM-P3-L4-RR01
